arguments.sql_query:
WITH asthma_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
), budesonide_exposed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 939259
)
SELECT
  'budesonide' AS controller_medication,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ap.person_id) AS diagnosed_asthma_patients_received_medication
FROM asthma_patients ap
JOIN budesonide_exposed be
  ON ap.person_id = be.person_id;

content.text: Budesonide is one asthma controller medication. Among patients diagnosed with asthma, 19,428 received budesonide.
